reason: Strawberry cheesecake matcha and hot chocolate with torched meringue are exactly the kind of thing I'd try and post when I'm walking the West Village on a Saturday. I'm only there on weekends, so it's a try-it-once-or-twice thing, not a daily habit.
objection: It's a café tucked inside another shop, so I'm not sure the space or the cups look good enough on camera to be worth stopping for over the places I already know. And it closes at noon, so if I roll in late I miss it.
